title: Ability
description: Code for Live that the person allowed an agent to run for good ("Always" on a proposal's card): one file, <abilities_dir>/<name>.json. The code is exactly what the card showed. The app never edits it in place.

name.description: The ability's name, and its file's. An agent's tool for it is ability_<name>.

does.description: One plain sentence saying what it does.

params.description: Its parameters. In the code their values are in the dict `args`. One without a default is required.

code.description: Python for Live. It may call use("other_ability", {...}), with the name written out.

session.description: The Ask session whose card was answered with Always; empty when it was kept another way.
